name: what_if
description: Recalculate the business on the page with changed figures and/or protection actions. Returns the bad year (1-in-20 loss), typical year, share of profit at risk and lowest cash balance, before and after. Pass only what changes. Money is EUR per year. Any field name from DATA.business is also accepted.

rate_fixed_months.description: months the current loan rate stays fixed, 0 to 12

energy_fixed_pct.description: share of energy on a fixed-price contract, 0 to 100

energy_fixed_months.description: months the fixed energy contract still runs, 0 to 12

purchases.description: annual purchases of materials or goods, EUR

pass_on_pct.description: share of purchase price rises passed on to customers, 0 to 100

minimum_wage_share_pct.description: share of payroll paid at minimum wage, 0 to 100

usd_purchases.description: annual purchases paid in US dollars, EUR

cash.description: cash in the bank today, EUR

fix_loan_rate.description: true to fix the loan rate with a swap or refinancing

fix_energy_prices.description: true to move all energy to a fixed-price contract now

pass_on_80pct.description: true to pass on 80% of purchase price rises

lock_dollar_rate.description: true to hedge US dollar purchases with a forward contract

name: shock
description: Apply a custom 12-month economic shock to the business on the page. Moves build up over the year and fixed contracts are respected. Returns the effect on annual profit by cost line, profit after the shock and the lowest cash balance. Pass only what moves.

energy_pct.description: change in energy prices, percent, e.g. 30

euribor_pp.description: change in 3-month Euribor, percentage points, e.g. 1 or -0.5

purchase_prices_pct.description: change in the prices of what the business buys, percent

inflation_pct.description: general inflation over the next 12 months, percent; drives indexed rent and pay rises

sales_index_pct.description: change in the sales index the business follows, percent, e.g. -5

eur_usd_pct.description: change in the EUR/USD rate, percent; negative means a weaker euro and dearer US goods

oil_pct.description: change in oil prices, percent; affects fuel and delivery

name: compare_clients
description: List the advisor's saved client businesses, worst first: bad-year loss, share of profit at risk, biggest risk, whether cash runs short and whether the alert level is crossed. Clients appear as codes (C1, C2, ...); write the code and the page shows the name.

limit.description: how many clients to return, default 10
